title: Document to editable PPTX

upstream.role: requirement source; no upstream code copied

notes: Extracted from the evaluator of the paper's final Creation evaluation with the Lite delta and the release edits.
agentswe/pptx-evaluator-runtime:0819 is the pinned ubuntu image (same image id); mapped to ubuntu-base.

The evaluator's LibreOffice root (images.json pptx-libreoffice, exported to deps/libreoffice/root) and the env's aspose-legacy/ are built from sha256-pinned downloads; parity with the paper roots is checked after the build.

Runnable: a smoke with deepseek-flash for every role (runtime effort high; search through the per-run search front, 9 calls, all HTTP 200) reached the Result judge: held-out test_001 = 13 (scoreable, contract valid, publishable; 1 judge call, 0 failures). Dev round 1 = 0, audited: on dev_001 the candidate's own .NET rasterizer exited 1 without a writable HOME (the frozen candidate sets HOME/TMPDIR itself); on dev_002 its single search query yielded no usable rows and it gave up (the same parsing code worked on held-out). The Builder ran to the 3600 s session limit; the session-timeout freeze check passed.

Release change (2026-10-10): adapter/eval-template/solution/run_eval.py normalize_evaluation_state reads the judge's prose (assessment, major_errors) as an infrastructure marker only when it holds the standalone token INFRASTRUCTURE_ERROR or INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID (underscores, any case, no letter, digit or underscore immediately before or after). The previous rule turned every non-alphanumeric into '_' and matched substrings, so prose such as 'evaluator-side infrastructure errors' voided a scored case. The harness, the transport and the judge's structured evaluation_state mark infrastructure as before, and verify_score.py reads the state run_eval writes.
